payload.name: Extract travel-location state memories
payload.description: During extraction, apply when a participant mentions a past vacation, trip, or travel photo with a named place and a time period, and no location-state or event candidate exists for that mention.
content: During candidate extraction, convert explicit travel/vacation mentions into state/event candidates: record that the speaker was at the named place during the stated time period, resolving relative time from the session timestamp.
If the named place is a city, include its unambiguous country in the same memory; do not guess when the city name maps to more than one country.
Stop after one candidate per distinct place-and-time mention; do not add candidates for places shown in photos or mentioned only as context without claiming the speaker was there.

solves: Travel or vacation statements that anchor a speaker to a specific place and time are often skipped during candidate extraction, leaving later questions about the speaker's location unanswerable. This Skill applies when a participant describes a past trip, vacation, or travel photo with a named place and a time reference. It must not apply when a place is mentioned without claiming the speaker was there, or when the named city's country is ambiguous.
